events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_partial $7.06 (model confidence 0.82)
events.body:
RydeTAXI, so the meter reflects distance and the detour's extra km enter the fare [F6][RD-2]. The record shows one measured off-route segment 09:13–09:24, 6.58 km driven where the optimal route covers 1.57 km, i.e. +5.01 km, up to 1578 m off the optimal route [F3][RD-1].

No exemption applies. There is no traffic incident on the replaced stretch — the trace marks RD-4(a) as failed and the only road-condition facts are speed bands [F9][F10][F11][F12][RD-4]. RD-4(b) bands are corroboration only and cannot exempt a segment on their own [F9][RD-4].

Nor did the rider agree. There are no in-app chat messages at all [F7][RD-5]. The driver's account that AYE was crawling and flooding rests solely on his post-trip statement, which is a claim, not rider consent [F8][RD-5]. No rider message before 09:13:55 names any place, so RD-3(a) does not apply, and the driver chose the deviation himself without informing the rider, so RD-3(b) leaves the extra km countable [F7][F8][RD-3]. The heavy rain [F13] is context, not a policy excuse, and the unexempted segment therefore stands as a route deviation [RD-1].

Refund = $1.4098/km × the drivable extra distance [F4][F6][RD-2]. Using the traced values: 5.34 km × $1.4098/km = $7.5283, i.e. $7.53; restricted to the unexempted segment's own extra km (5.01 km), 5.01 km × $1.4098/km = $7.0631, i.e. $7.06. I award the lower, segment-specific figure of $7.06 so that only the measured unexempted segment is refunded [F3][F4][RD-2]; the remaining corridor/matching mileage in the fare-excess is not refundable. Non-refundable: the waiting component, which is $0.00 here [F6][RD-3(c)].

The driver profile (3 disputes, 2 upheld, but 0 route disputes upheld in 90 days) does not by itself decide anything and, with route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0, no flag_account follows [F15][RD-6]. Safety screen: I read the complaint and the driver's statement; there is no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation [F7][F8] — SAFE-1/SAFE-2 not triggered. Evidence is sufficient: the segment, the fare and the per-km rate are all recorded [F3][F4][F6].
